source._version_note: Retargeted 2026-10-22 to mimir-3.2.3, the latest GA (published 2026-10-22). The tag is `mimir-3.2.3`, NOT `v3.2.3` -- the repo also carries mimir-distributed-* Helm chart tags and pre-fork v1.x tags, so retarget_tag_pattern pins the product line. go.mod at mimir-3.2.3 declares `go 1.26.10` (3.2.1 said 1.26.7) with no toolchain directive, so the builder must ship >= 1.26.10 under GOTOOLCHAIN=local; the golang:1.26 builder is moved to its latest patch by retarget.py (L-A112). No go.work (L-A50).
source._vendor_note: Mimir COMMITS vendor/ (338 modules), so -mod=vendor builds offline straight from the checkout, same as tempo and unlike loki. A dep_bump still requires a re-vendor or the bumped module never physically reaches the build. Sets source.vendor_committed so the vendor stage KEEPS upstream's own vendor/ (338 modules) instead of running `go mod tidy -e && go mod vendor` over it. The knob applies only while dep_bumps is empty -- bumps are stated as floors by `go mod edit -require` and need the following tidy to MVS-reconcile them, so the moment a bump is added the normal tidy+re-vendor path returns automatically.
source._submodule_note: ./mimir-build-image and ./operations/mimir-mixin-tools/screenshots are SEPARATE go modules holding CI and docs tooling. Neither is imported by any cmd/, and neither is built or shipped. The product binaries are all in the root module, so this is not the etcd multi-module case.
source.source_date_epoch_provenance: the time release 3.2.6-CE-ubuntu24.04-r1 was cut (2026-11-23T15:10:14Z), by scripts/retarget.py: ReadyStack dates an image by when its release was packaged (owner 2026-11-10), recorded here once and used by every rebuild of the release; it builds upstream commit 634964f95676, dated 2026-11-17T23:59:19Z (source.commit_epoch).

binaries_from_source.name: mimir
binaries_from_source._note: Makefile:250 MIMIR_VERSION := github.com/grafana/mimir/pkg/util/version and :255 stamps Version/Branch/Revision there -- NOT into main, as tempo does. Version is the contents of ./VERSION, the bare version with no leading v (@VERSION_BARE@). Revision is the short sha of the release tag's commit (@COMMIT:8@). `stringlabels` is in upstream's GO_TAGS and is not optional decoration: it selects a different in-memory label representation, so dropping it changes memory behaviour under load.

binaries_from_source.name: mimirtool
binaries_from_source._note: The operator CLI: loads and lints rule groups, inspects the ruler store, runs remote-read queries. Same module and therefore the same dependency set as mimir itself, so it adds no CVE surface. cmd/metaconvert (a block-metadata migration one-shot) and cmd/query-tee (a query-comparison proxy for upstream's own testing) are deliberately NOT built.
